name: takaflow-sample
description: Personal expense and savings dashboard prototype built on the P12 public personal ledger case data.
features: salary-first home dashboard with Spent / Remaining
natural-language expense entry with review step
receipt / screenshot image upload with review step
folder-style savings goals with DPS projection
save-this-month allocation that updates the ledger immediately
Your Month summary and calendar view
search and sorting on the spending list
editable salary (modal and inline on home)
localStorage persistence of profile, salary, expenses, and goals
logout returning to the onboarding/login screen

principles: no red for negative states; use the dark-green accent
dark green surfaces use off-white type
paper noise + grain overlay on the full page background
goal notepads tilt and lift for a playful feel
spent figures capped at monthly income

known_limits: receipt and natural-language understanding are mock rules, not AI OCR
ledger persists per-browser via localStorage, not synced
spending beyond income is clamped for display; the raw totals remain in the list
